Job Description Summary
To support the Logistics Team in creating export documentation for shipments from the GE HealthCare Cork plant, while gaining a foundational understanding of logistics & supply chain within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The role involves learning key logistics & planning processes with guidance from experienced team members and mentors.
Job Description
Job Description Summary
Logistics Student:
To gain experience as part of a Distribution Team with responsibility for preparing and creating all export documentation for all deliveries ex- GE HealthCare Cork plant
To Learn various aspects of Logistics within the Supply chain of a Lean Pharmaceutical Manufacturing facility with guidance from current employees.
Work Closely with Customer Service, Planning, Quality, Commercial and Manufacturing departments to respond swiftly to customers regarding issues with products & deliveries.
Works closely with Freight Forwarders on pre- booking shipments via all modes (Air, Sea Road)
Responsibilities include assisting with the following:
Coordinate and communicate shipment delivery requirements to Freight Forwarders
Liaise with Internal Departments (QP) to ensure on time batch release for Shipments
Create Sales & Purchase Orders for European, US & Global Intercompany Markets
Complete all required export documentation for GE Healthcare Customers
Support other product shipments such as Samples, Intercompany shipments & other Inventory as required.
Work Closely with Customer Service and Manufacturing to respond swiftly to customers regarding any issues with products & deliveries.
Ensure all processes and documentation is in accordance with GEHC & ITC (International Trade Control) compliance requirements
Prepare such documents as Invoices, Certs of Origin, Certs of Analysis, Picking Lists etc.etc. for required market.
Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Job Description
GE Healthcare Ireland Ltd
Engineering Graduate
GE Healthcare Cork Ireland
GE Healthcare Ireland Limited manufactures and distributes X-ray and MRI Contrast Media for internal and external customers worldwide. As part of the Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) business of GE Healthcare, at Cork we support the PDx vision of being the best-in-class supply chain delivering the right dose to the right patient at the right time.
GE HealthCare’s purpose not only drives us to build a healthier future, but to create a world where healthcare has no limits. A world where care is at the heart of all we do. Care that doesn’t know the meaning of impossible. That started with one idea and will endure for thousands. The kind of care that sparks the most precious thing of all: hope.
We are currently seeking Engineering Graduates with Electrical, Mechanical, Process Engineering or Automation knowledge. As a GE graduate you will assume full responsibility and contribute as a functional professional. You will learn from, work with and network with GE Healthcare Professionals from all segments across the company.
An graduate position with GE Healthcare Ireland provides you with
Hands on Experience while Promoting your Personal and Professional growth.
Induction Training.
Mentoring.
On going Job Training.
Experience in Filling, Packaging, Utilities & Automation
Main Duties & Responsibilities:
Assist in the set up and management of the programs for utilities, production & Packaging.
Supporting site safety programs, improving our site standard in doing so.
Ensure that all health, safety & environmental requirements are fulfilled in accordance with the responsibilities defined in the company safety & environmental statements
Set up of specifications and standard procedures to align with industry standards.
Updating & maintaining Maintenance documents & drawings.
Act as SME for internal and external inspections programs.
Monitoring of day-to-day performance of site equipment.
Measuring and maximizing the uptime of equipment, supporting the site reliability program.
Ensuring that a critical spare parts list for their system is identified and appropriate levels of spares are maintained.
The definition and scoping of all process improvement activities relating to the system.
Anticipating, solving or escalating problems as appropriate.
Supporting design reviews associated with equipment purchases.
Troubleshooting of performance trends.
Risk assessments and mitigation projects relating to system performance.
Support of new product introductions and introductions of new equipment.
Representing Utilities / Maintenance department on site-based teams involved in implementing new technology, products or business processes to the site.
Continuous improvement programs and all performance improvement projects.
Reviewing and approval of changes to operating procedures and the change control process relating to the system.
Working in a collaborative manner within the Process Teams structure and contributes to investigations, NC and CAPA closure.
Develop a “reliability” cantered asset care strategy for the sites equipment, with the following core pillars: equipment criticality and spares assessment, predictive maintenance techniques, fit for purpose PM program, technician driven RCA program and FMEA techniques.
Ensuring that plant and equipment is operating in a compliant manner and that all activities are conducted to meet GMP regulations, site and corporate quality standards and any additional regulatory requirements as required
Continuous improvement
Continue to drive improvement through certified lines and other lean programs.
Suggestions: surface ideas and suggestions from team. Support suggestions scheme program.
Drive CI within shift: Be proactive in surfacing continuous improvement initiatives. Drive improved yields and efficiency.
Principal Qualifications Required:
Pursuing a relevant third level qualification in Bachelor of Engineering or Science
Candidates must have a minimum of 2.1 Grade in their degree course.
Strong academic performance and extracurricular achievement.
Exceptional interpersonal skills and proven track record of teamwork, adaptability, innovation, initiative and integrity.

Job Description
GE HealthCare is een toonaangevende wereldwijde innovator op het gebied van medische technologie en digitale oplossingen met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in de gezondheidszorgsector en ongeveer 50.000 werknemers wereldwijd. We stellen medische professionals in staat snellere, beter geïnformeerde beslissingen te nemen via intelligente apparaten, data-analyse, applicaties en services, ondersteund door ons Edison-platform. We opereren in het centrum van een ecosysteem dat werkt aan precisiegezondheid - het digitaliseren van de gezondheidszorg, het verbeteren van de productiviteit en van de resultaten voor patiënten, zorgverleners, gezondheidssystemen en onderzoekers over de hele wereld. Bij GE Healthcare in Eindhoven produceren we radionuclide waarmee Radiofarmaceutische producten worden gemaakt.
Doel van de functie:
Zelfstandig uitvoeren en bewaken van het volledige productieproces van radionucliden, van voorbereiding en bestraling tot het correct afsluiten van het proces.
Kerntaken bij deze functie:
Voorbereiden, spoelen en afsluiten van targets.
Maken en controleren van cyclotronberekeningen..
Verzorgen van een goede afstemming met betrokken afdelingen rondom de bestraling.
Zorgdragen voor een veilige en correcte uitvoering van de werkzaamheden volgens vastgestelde protocollen en voorschriften.
